item.question: How does struc2mapGAN improve upon existing methods for generating cryo-EM density maps?
item.answer: Struc2mapGAN uses a generative adversarial network (GAN) approach to produce more accurate experimental-like cryo-EM density maps from PDB structures. It enhances learning efficiency with curated training data and integrates SmoothL1Loss into its model, improving performance over traditional simulation-based approaches by better capturing complex structural features.
